primary_estimand.name: location-resolved dive-depth niche thickness
primary_estimand.z_semantics: maximum organism dive depth for one qualifying dive event
primary_estimand.claim_boundary: realized location-resolved dive-state support, not full continuous water-column occupancy or fundamental niche

depth_bin_rationale: fixed powers-of-two bins above the source study's 0.5 m qualifying threshold; no empirical quantiles

weighting.within_trip: equal weight across qualifying location-resolved dives
weighting.reason: prevent longer or more frequently sampled trips from dominating support mass

observation_process.depth_logging: source methods report depth every 1 s
observation_process.reason_no_primary_ipw: GPS location failure can depend on unobserved position and surface opportunity; primary contract fails closed rather than asserting missing-at-random

cluster_split.algorithm: sort unique birdIDs within stratum by SHA256('odsp-gate-d-tawaki-v1|<site>|<year>|<birdID>'); first ceil(0.25*n) are sealed

allowed: declare estimable primary cells under frozen thresholds
estimate weighted P(Z|X,Y) in those cells
generate cluster-bootstrap uncertainty under frozen rules
forbidden: change grid size after viewing thickness
change depth bins after viewing thickness
drop birds/trips because their outcome is inconvenient

sealed_answer_check.definition: mean_w[log p_model(Z|X,Y) - log p_marginal(Z|site,year)] on sealed qualifying events in model-pool-eligible cells
sealed_answer_check.smoothing: Jeffreys Dirichlet pseudocount 0.5 per depth bin
sealed_answer_check.weighting: same equal-bird-trip weighting as primary support
sealed_answer_check.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over sealed birdID, 2000 replicates

decision_categories.estimable_and_generalizing: coverage gates pass and 95% bootstrap CI lower bound for log-score difference > 0
decision_categories.estimable_but_generalization_unresolved: coverage gates pass and 95% CI includes 0
decision_categories.estimable_but_non_generalizing: coverage gates pass and 95% CI upper bound < 0

always_report: all admitted and excluded birds/trips with reasons
located versus unlocated dive denominators by site-year
number of estimable and unavailable x-y cells
sealed log-score difference and bootstrap CI
primary 5 km result before 2.5/10 km sensitivity
do_not_claim: continuous water-column occupancy from dive maxima alone
